description:
Our most popular tour contains everything you should know about Berlin. Discover the best of Berlin with our great city guides: compact, entertaining and well-researched! Embark on an exciting tour of discovery with us to the most famous sights of the city, rounded off by interesting facts and surprising anecdotes, which can often surprise even Berliners themselves.

You'll see:
- Brandenburg Gate
- Reichstag
- Hitler’s Bunker
- The Berlin Wall
- Checkpoint Charlie
- Holocaust Memorial
- Book Burning Memorial
- The Prussian “City Palace”
- Unter den Linden (Royal Boulevard)
- Friedrichstrasse Cabaret Mile
- 17 June Memorial
- Former Luftwaffe HQ
- Former SS & Gestapo HQ
- Memorial to the Victims of War & Tyranny
- Topography of Terror Museum
…and many more!
hostdescription:
For almost 30 years, the historical walking tours of Original Berlin Walks have been an integral part of the Berlin sightseeing scene. Our award-winning tours are not only thoroughly researched, but also entertaining and flavored with amusing anecdotes, too. Our guides have an academic education and speak perfect English or German.

Discover our public tours or book a private tour that is tailored exactly to your needs. Let yourself be carried away by our guides and discover Berlin as you have never seen it before!
locationDescription: We meet in front of Starbucks at Hackescher Markt and then experience the highlights of the city together

reviews.text: Anneke was a great tour guide. She was very knowledgeable about the history of Berlin and was also very willing to answer questions and give recommendations for the rest of our time in the city.
Paul was lovely - so engaging and knowledgeable, we had a wonderful time on the tour and enjoyed learning and seeing so much of lovely Berlin!

I had a very short time in Berlin and with a tour by Johnny I was able to see all the main historical sites. He gave us so much in-depth detail which I appreciated a lot, really digging into the history. Since we covered a lot of ground, he gave us suggestions on what to go explore on our own. Highly recommended tour.

Fantastic tour that is a relatively quick way to experience some of the highlights of Berlin. There is a lot that you wouldn’t get out of it without a guide. Glen did a wonderful job at making sure we were all cared for and getting everything we should from the tour.

We were booked to go on a day that it was pouring with rain, we messaged the day of the tour and they kindly said we could go the next day (no rain luckily!) they were super accommodating and flexible.
We had Canadian Chris as our guide and he was great; fun and lots of stories to tell and his own input. He clearly knew and loved Berlin and it’s history very well he even made some of it funny. The time passed very quickly- highly recommend.

The tour was amazing! Good to know though that the tour groups can be larger, I think ours was around 20. We were initially concerned about this but once Glen started the tour all concern melted away as he and the tour was amazing!! His passion and story telling ability made this a very special experience. <3

Jasper was a great guide. Due to the small group size, he was able to respond to questions very individually. He has extensive knowledge of the history of Berlin and was able to tell us many details about the places visited. I can fully recommend the tour!

Rebecca gave our private group a wonderful historical tour of Berlin. She was extremely personable and accommodating, and we enjoyed getting to know each other. She was very knowledgeable, and I’d recommend the tour to anyone interested.
Enjoyed this. Xavier very good. It was actually longer than 3.5hrs and I’d made plans I couldn’t get out of afterwards so maybe keep that in mind if booking.

Our city guide Tobi was great!!!! His knowledge of Berlin and the history was exceptionally good, very informative and super interesting!
It was a total of four highly interesting hours and about a 8 km walk. We can recommend Tobi thousand percent 👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼

We throughly enjoyed the tour. Tobi is very knowledgeable about berlin and has excellent story telling skills. His quirky personality made the tour fun and welcoming. Bonus for brining his Canadian suite for the occasion. Highly recommend.

Loved this tour. Our guide Tobi was super informative, funny, witty and an overall great guide. Definitely recommend to anyone traveling to Berlin. It’s excellent value and you get to see loads. Thanks again Tobi

This is an excellent activity to do on your 1st day in Berlin. It is a great way a to see all the major sights in a short period of time and a great way to familiarize yourself with the city. Our guide was not Lars , however I cannot remember his name.. He is originally from Australia. He was wonderful, funny, and very engaging and and made the time seem to go by very fast. He kept the tour interesting. Meet up point was straightforward.
A truly wonderful tour! Tom was an amazing guide who kept us all engaged and revelling in the history of this amazing city
Campbell was an excellent and knowledge tour guide. He kept it interesting with lots of fun facts. Friendly and great at giving local information. The time flew in. I would highly recommend

Ciaran was very knowledgeable and able to answer all the questions the group had. A very interesting city was brought to life in a factual and animated manner!

Great value for money and in my opinion a must do in Berlin!
Was amazing, interesting and professional

Highly recommend this walking tour! It’s an excellent way to learn so much history, see the beautiful city, and meet some new friends. Tobi was the best tour guide, would do this tour again!! We loved Berlin.
I learned so much on this tour. Our guide was Tobi, who was entertaining and a true Berliner. Excellent humor and a balance of delicacy with the dark history of Berlin. Highly recommend!

Rebecca was my guide on the Discover Berlin tour. She is a delightful young woman transplanted from western Canada who loves history and has a gift for sharing it. I appreciated all the details Rebecca shared that you don't always find in history books.

Great tour! we took the tour the first day we arrived and we are so glad we did. Our tour guide equipped us with a great context of the city so we could explore ourselves the rest of our trip! Our tour guide had a great sense of humor too!

The tour was a good experience with an elaborate amount of historical information about the city. I appreciated our tour guides sense of humor and positive attitude especially with the weather not being ideal. One suggestion is to spread out the number of stops as we would walk a few blocks and then have to digest new information. Overall a good experience!

Even though it was raining, Scott provided the best guide and service professionally. It was the most cost-effective program to have a better understanding in Berlin history & to make an international friends.
Absolutely brilliant tour by Glenn. Super knowledgable, friendly and helpful. A font of knowledge of the history of berlin. Thoroughly recommended. Excellent value for money for 3.5hrs.
Great tour to start my berlin trip. Xavier was very knowledgeable with a good sense of humour. Answered all the questions. Good tour.
hopefully you get Steve who was great at retelling the history and knew all the facts, everything he said was interesting and impactful

I understand that Lars is sick, and we had the experience with Glenn, he is an excellent guide! He has a lot of knowledge of the history of Berlin and was a very kind and funny person. A great option if you want to know the history of this beautiful city

Great way to start out our visit to Berlin! Ryan’s knowledge about the history and sites of Berlin was incredible. Also liked how he took on us a few detours to learn about the art and music scene of the city.

We had a fabulous tour of Berlin with Matti. His personal stories and knowledge of the area was great, and it didn’t feel like we were on the tour long at all because he filled every minute! Would 100% recommend to anyone visiting.

Learned so much in the short period as well as certain stories I’ve never heard of. The guide was wonderful! Very educational. For the price I would say this was the best tour I did in Berlin. We didn’t exactly go into any of the museums but he let us know which one we’re worth our time and which ones were tourist traps and a waste. He also had personal stories about the Berlin Walk that I found fascinating. Definitely worth it! And wear comfy shoes!
this tour was fun and informative. Gregor is a great person with amazing storytelling skills and knows how to engage his audience. totally recommend

Very fun and informative walking tour! Learned so much about the city center and have a much better appreciation of the history that happened here in Berlin. It gave me ideas on where I wanted to spend more time for the rest of my stay!

Very informative and fun historical walking tour of Berlin in 3.5 hours and we also get a nice little break in-between for coffee and restroom. I joined the day before the Berlin Marathon so knowing the history and recognizing the landmarks makes me appreciate it much more before my run. I met some other runners in my group so everyone had the same idea. Would highly recommend this experience if you're visiting Berlin for the first time. It's a great way to get to know the city and its rich history!

It's a great option to visit iconic sights of Berlin without losing so much time. The guide Jonathan explained every detail excellent...
Everything is walking, in the middle of the tour they give a small break to eat something fast or eat.
I recommend seeing the weather of the day they will book in advance if there is a chance of rain, bring an umbrella
Glen was a extremely informative and well informed guide. He really delivered on keeping things pleasant but serious at times too for some of the more serious tourist portions.
Our guide Tobi was from eastern Germany and shared fascinating stories not just about Germany but his childhood growing up. It was a fun and informative tour. Highly recommended!
While we did cover all major spots of the city the tour felt a bit rushed, and was lacking that personal touch. Go for it if you have limited time in the city

What a great way to see Berlin! Giorgio, our tour guide was amazing. He made this tour fun, engaging, and most importantly of all, informative. We learned a lot about the history of Berlin in a few short hours. This tour is definitely a must do for your visit to the city. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone.
The tour is worth it, Pip was an amazing tour guide! Trying to see all the historical landmark on my own would've been difficult, especially without context but they made it easy and fun.

This was a very informative tour. Our guide, Giorgio, was a total history nerd and knew a ton of information and made it very fun! You can tell he enjoys his job :-) We went almost 4 full hours, so it’s best if you are not scheduled too tightly with something after. Well worth it.
A wonderful tour, very informative and enjoyable. A great way to orientate yourself for your first day in Berlin. Glen was an excellent guide.

Our guide for the day was Glen, who provided an amazing experience.

His delivery of information in a thoughtful and respectful manner, covering a number of significant and controversial historical topics could not have been better.

I highly recommend taking this tour for anyone who visits Berlin.

The tour was great, a lot of history and you get to see all the best sights to help you familiarise yourself with the city. Campbell also gave us awesome recommendations for food and things to do at the end! He was humorous and made the experience fun! Thanks so much Campbell

Not only was our tour guide, warm and friendly, but his sheer knowledge of the events at this concentration camp are incredibly impressive. He really helped us understand the gravity of everything that occurred at this historic sight. I sincerely feel that I am a tiny bit better of a person now due to the knowledge shared with us by our tour guide, Richard.
If you are English speaking definitely pick the English only tour as you maximize your time and how much you learn. The tour was great and went for just over 4 hours.

What’s great is it gets you out and into the streets of Berlin. But beware this is a massive tour group - more than 30 people, which makes the tour feel unwieldy and completely impersonal. There should absolutely be a cap on the number but this group recruits from Airbnb and elsewhere… Guide was fine- new to Berlin and doing his best.
Great walking tour by Xavier. He is funny, witty and an amazing story teller. He go through the tour is pouring rain and never lost his charm or enthusiasm for the history of this beautiful city.

Tobi was a great guide! He connected with everyone in the group and took his time to go through the history of every place we visited. I learned so much in the few hours on this tour, very appreciative :) Excellent tour and strongly recommend it!

You will learn a lot about Berlin’s history and its top attractions from this tour told by a very knowledgeable guide. Ours was Jorg who has a master’s degree in history and politics. Well worth the price.
This tour is an excellent way to begin a vacation in Berlin. The sights and monuments explained by the tour Guide were on point and highly recommend.

This tour was beyond amazing! Pip was such a stellar tour guide. Personable, illuminating, brilliant, charming, and chockfull of history and tidbits. I highly recommend this tour if you want an in-depth overview of the Berlin’s dense history. FYI: we did stop for a break and snack, which was great! Thank you for such an amazing day! I left very moved and with understanding a deeper historical context about Berlin!

Our tour with ANJA was great. Anja is a totally empathetic, humorous guide with a brilliant knowledge that went way beyond the usual. You could also ask her "hub stuff" and Anja knew a lot of interesting things about it. Simply ingenious, we could have walked with her through Berlin for hours. even our 15 year old "Pubertier" was thrilled (1000 points)

This was an excellent tour with lots of information told in a great storytelling way. I would highly recommend this to anyone who is visiting Berlin. Do this on the first day and you will get a good feel of the place along with great historical background that would give you a lot of context. The guide was really knowledgable and engaging. Thoroughly enjoyed the experience.
Lars gave us an informative, thoughtful and inclusive tour, meaning that he made sure everyone felt part of the experience and he offered us different perspectives to consider. It was terrific!!!

Xavier is a great guide! Very nice visit of Berlin with someone passionate about Berlin's history. Very nice visit, loved it. Perfect for learning about Berlin's history and walking around the most important places. I absolutely recommend it, to be done at the beginning of the stay to better orient yourself afterwards.

We had a great tour with Chris, very engaging and enjoyable. We learned a lot and most of it will stay with us because of the way Chris told the stories! A huge thanks to him for a very worthwhile tour.

He knew the topic and he did a very good presentation of what was important for us to know.
He maintain our attention by making jokes relevant to the topic.
I think he was very good.

The tour guide named Jorg was friendly and had great energy. The 3 hour walking tour covers the history of the city through the iconic landscapes and settings. There was a half hour break at the Charlie Checkpoint. Jorg also recommended a few museums to visit. I would not have known which museums to visit during my short stay had I not done this tour. I recommend doing this in the beginning of your Berlin trip to appreciate the city’s incongruous yet fascinating architecture and landscape.
Jon was great at providing an in depth dive in the history of Berlin, and I felt a lot more educated after the trip.
this is a good way to start a trip to Berlin because you can get a lot of sites done and then double back as necessary. I booked a private 1:1 tour, which I recommend
Good value for money. My guide Xavier was very knowledgeable on German history and it was the perfect introduction to the city! Recommend
Thank you Xavier, what a super presentation and amazing story (fact) telling ..until next time it was great having a few chat here and there. Much appreciated!
One interesting city to visit , Lars been patiently answer all the questions. After today tour I definitely learned more about history of Berlin . Highly recommend!

Glen is awesome! I highly recommend this tour. Two things to note is that you need to be fluent in English and it’s fast paced walking. Otherwise, you get an overview of the history, Glen is friendly and knowledgable, and he has a binder full of pictures to show what it looked like before and after.
Tobi was a great tour guide. I feel like we really covered a ton of ground during the tour and I learned a ton of information! Great value for what I paid

Great trip! Amazing way to see and learn about Berlin history in a condensed period of time. I was pleasantly surprised with how robust the tour was. Our guide Campbell was very knowledgeable and super funny! Highly recommend

This was a really excellent tour and well worth doing. Campbell was very knowledgeable and his delivery was great - informative and amusing. This tour could be done at any time in a Berlin stay but particularly good at the beginning to inform the rest of the trip. Campbell was happy to provide recommendations of things to do, places to eat etc. Highly recommended.

This was a wonderful and informative tour.Our host Eran was interesting and humorous, and we took his advice and checked out Rausch- a wonderful cafe treat! Topics covered were very respectfully presented, and the extra time spent in locations greatly enhanced the experience. Terrific!
Lars was a great guide, she’s very informative, knowledgeable and easy going! We really enjoyed the tour and felt like we got a lot out of it!

One of the most informative, passionate, professional and engaging tours I have been to. I got to know so much about Berlin’s history in just under 4 hours. Would definitely recommend this experience to anyone visiting Berlin, even if just for 1 day.
Great way to hit all of the must-sees in half a day. Scott had a lot of info to share and other thoughtful insights well!

We love city tours because the guides can efficiently show us the highlights of the city. This was a great tour to explore the early history of Berlin, and our guide took us to sites that we would have struggled to find on our own. It was a really hot day, and our guide even planned a refreshment break, which was appreciated.
great Tour received from Jonathan! He has a lot to say! Occasionally some dry information, but alternated with fun facts.

Absolutely fantastic tour. Gloria has a wealth of information about the history, the humanity and contemporary Berlin. We were captivated the entire tour (which ended up being closer to 4 hours.
We loved the meeting location...a great venue we wouldn't have discovered on our own...and it's impressive that we saw everything on foot. I expected we'd be taking Public transportaiton.
Georgia was bright, articulate, loud enough, very experienced on this tour, and funny. She's a highly skilled guide and it is evident that she enjoys this work. You will see just about EVERYTHING you need to see in Berlin - excluding holocaust victims from the Roma, disabled, gays, communists, etc. It was very single narrative history....I regret that more voices were not privileged in the human tragedy and harm.
Our guide was awesome. (Forgot his name, but he mentioned that he was Scottish). His personality, attitude and humour made this tour quite memorable!
It was a pretty large group around 30. It was not a bad tour but with that many people it’s harder to feel engaged.

Our tour guide Heidi was amazing — she was super nice about answering extra questions, making sure we were taking breaks for water and rest, and just keeping everyone safe and happy :) I loved Heidi’s storytelling and appreciated how knowledgeable she was! Also, we didn’t go too fast or see too many stops in one trip—it was really nicely paced.
Anika was a wonderful guide! We got to see all the interesting places and all the important facts. I can really recommend Anika!

Scott was excellent and did a great job of summarising what is very complicated history. He kept everyone engaged and you could really feel his passion and authenticity when he spoke. We thoroughly enjoyed the tour and really appreciate Scott’s time to share his perspective and history with us.
Our guide was Campbell and he did an amazing job. Deep well of knowledge, good pacing, visual aids . . . the total package. I thought this was an excellent value for the money.

Campbell was an excellent tour guide! He was extremely knowledgeable, witty, and engaging. Even with a large group size, we were able to hear with the entire time and get great views everywhere we went.
Good intro to Berlin history, Giorgio was very good in telling the story and answering our questions. I also liked he would ask us questions to make us think and to make conversation.

A wonderful way to see the highlights of Berlin! My English speaking guide, Sarah, was very knowledgeable and kind. She was also very accommodating- our tour was on a very hot day and she always did her best to find our group shade and check in on everyone!

We had Glen, who was incredible! I was skeptical at first about a 3+ hour walking tour (too long, too much info), but the pace was comfortable, the information was exceptional, and on a very hot day in Berlin, Glen was mindful of logistical things like going from shade to shade and taking bathroom breaks. Highly recommend!

This was a great starting tour to cover the key sights, giving a background and overview of Berlin with good storytelling by our guide Ciaran.

The tour Group was about ~20 people but Ciaran kept the group together and engaged. We were also given a break for 10-15 mins for snacks/drinks and toilets.

Consider doing this at the start of your trip.
Our guide, Davide, was great and super knowledgeable. I feel like I’m now ready to really explore Berlin with this knowledge to underpin my understanding.
One of the best walking tours I have been on! Really complete history of Berlin. Less focus on the Cold War era than I expected.

One of the highlights of our trip! Highly recommended if you want to learn more about Berlin and it’s history. The breaks were also paced very well so everyone got to take toilet and snack breaks often. Very well planned!
Great tour, Scottish Sam was an amazing tour guide. He provided a great historical background to the places we saw and managed to make all the heavy history of Berlin manageable to grasp in 4h.

Our tour guide Walid was really nice :)
Great story teller, very interesting and friendly.
He adapted the visit to our pace and made our day great !
We highly recommend him ☀️
Good tour to see all the basics. Groups tend to be on the larger side, but hosts do a good job keeping everyone engaged.

Our walk was wonderful, fun and super informative. Our guide Steve was charming and very funny. My 11 year old son enjoyed his jokes and entertaining storytelling. The walk is a great way for new visitors to get a sense of the city. Berlin has an unreal history, there’s so much to learn! Highly recommend!
Jacob was a great story teller. The rich historical knowledge and fun are what made this tour super awesome! Highly recommend going on this tour!

Our sightseeing tour was totally great! Our guide Jonathan K. was super pleasant and was able to convince through a lot of knowledge! Thanks to him, we were able to understand the history of the city of Berlin better and had quite a lot of fun with it! The tour even took a little longer, as Jonathan K. took an incredible amount of time with us.
Conclusion: Absolutely recommended!!!!
Heidi was a great guide! She’s very knowledgeable and a tremendous storyteller. I would def recommend for anyone that loves history and wants to learn more about Berlin.

This was a great tour! Ciaran, our guide, took us on a very in-depth tour of Berlin. He provided many interesting facts in a really fun way. I didn’t feel like there were any landmarks that we missed in the main area of Berlin.

I’d definitely recommend this trip to anyone looking for a “greatest hits” tour of the city.
We did the tour with Anika and it was just wonderful! Your knowledge is extensive and knew how to give us all the details about the city and landmarks! I would highly recommend it!

I expected this tour to be a simple city tour. It turned out to be a fantastic and engaging lesson in history, covering many sites I knew about and others I did not. Annika the guide related historical events back to what we are experiencing today around the world which left me with a lot of food for thought. Highly recommend!
Scott showed us the main sights of Berlin in a fun and engaging way. Best way to see Berlin and get an idea on the layout of the city.
Our guide was engaging and informative. It was a truly educational tour and there was plenty of time to ask questions etc. I would recommend to anyone that wants a deep dive into Berlin history.
Heidi was a wonderful tour guide and gave us an in-depth information about pre and post war Berlin. Her storytelling was informative and engaging. I’d definitely recommend this experience.
Heidi was a great host and very informative. She spoke slowly and with great detail of all the city of Berlin had to offer with its past and most resent history.
Lively and interesting tour with Steve! We thought the three hours of walking would be too much but it certainly didn't feel like it once he started telling stories about Berlin!

This was a great tour. There’s lots of walking on this tour but plenty of stops with descriptive story telling regarding all the key sites. My tip is to stand near your tour guide while walking between locations because you can get even more stories! The value for money is excellent too.
It was an amazing guided tour with a charismatic and fun tour guide we were totally satisfied!

This tour was a fantastic way to start our visit to Berlin! Heidi was an incredible guide and we enjoyed every minute of the tour. All 5 of us (including 2 teenagers and a 10 year old) thoroughly enjoyed it. Highly recommend!

This was a great comprehensive tour to cover the major sights, giving a great background and overview of Berlin with superb storytelling. I would recommend doing this near the beginning of your stay to hit the highlights to kick off your trip! We also had a break in the middle to grab a snack/drink, use the toilets and just rest which was nice!

Heidi gave a wonderful and informative tour that covered so much history, both long ago and more recent. She was clear and easy to follow, and we always knew what was happening next on the tour before we went, which I appreciated!
The guide had great historical knowledge of Berlin and was able to present her knowledge in a concise way. She was entertaining and captured the guests”attention. Very well done tour!

Having never been in Paris before, Lars made the city and its history come alive. He’s a great storyteller, considerate of the travelers and very personable. I highly recommend this tour. I have a greater appreciation of Paris and its history and know which sites I want to return to visit. The fact that my travel companion and I could book this private tour made our trip to Paris more special.

My tour guide was named Glen! He was amazing!!! Great information, perfect storytelling, photos from the past to support what we were currently seeing... pacing was perfect! Stopped under shade to point out important things. I could hear every word! I would highly recommend this tour to everyone I know! keep up the good work Glen!!

Glen was very knowledgeable and my teens were engaged and had an interest sparked in German history, they kept asking us questions afterwards about many of the historical events Glen described. We were only in Berlin for a day, we feel this was a great way to see a lot and it made us all want to come back for a longer stay! Thanks Glen!

Scott really made the history of this city come alive. His story telling was excellent and both our teenagers were fully engaged throughout - no
mean feat in 34 degree heat! Thank you. We would thoroughly recommend this tour.

Great experience! I recommend it. Our guide told stories and showed them photos of what the locations we were visiting were like. It's so worth it. Our guide named Glen was extremely friendly and made the tour more interesting ☺️

We had a terrific experience learning all about Berlin on this walking tour and would recommend this to one and all. The tour not only helped us understand the entirety of Berlin’s history and took us to spots which we would have otherwise missed, our guide (don’t remember the name) was a historian and provided SOOO much color that was fantastic!

It was extremely hot when we did the tour, but our guide was very kind to bake in water and drinks breaks, and ensure we always stood in the shade as he narrated the many tales of Berlin’s past.

Great value! Lots of locations to see! Scott our guide is obviously amazing. If you have a chance go with Scott. It was special, memorable, interesting and with lots of unique information and spots. Everything you ever want in a tour.

Really fantastic and thorough experience - highly recommend for anyone wanting to get out and learn about Berlins in depth history. AY was a fantastic host and her story telling was one id happily listen to again

I definitely recommend this tour to everyone visiting Berlin, Jakob was a great tour guide and seemed to know EVERYTHING. I learned a lot about the city I didn’t know previously and I really appreciated the knowledge.

A great tour of the key landmarks of Berlin. The tour guide was a historian, was very knowledgeable and gave us bite size pieces of history at each location, which were perfect length and easy to remember. I’d recommend this as an overview of Berlin. I would’ve wanted some more landmarks/ history and art of Eastern Berlin but that’s a subject for another tour then!

Loved this 4 hour walking tour! Got to see all the important places in Berlin and Jacob's story telling was absolutely captivating. He's extremely passionate about the history of Berlin and loves the city. Could not have hoped for anything more. I even screwed up my reservation and booked for the wrong day but had no problems rescheduling for the next day after missing it on the first day altogether. Thank you!

Took a tour with Caroline who was extremely knowledgeable of the area, providing tips and ideas for food or places to see. She also provided a wonderful history lesson of all the major sites of Berlin.

Well worth it to take this tour on your first full day's visit to gather ideas, learn about Berlin and get many of the major landmarks of the city viewed in a well paced tour.

Great value!

One of the best tours I’ve attended, full of historical knowledge. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and made sure we visited as many places as possible during our visit in Berlin. I’d recommend this tour 100% to anyone who wants to learn as much as possible about Berlin’s history. Note that you’ll be walking a lot, so make sure you bring comfortable shoes and water. There will be a 10-minute break before the last hour of the tour near coffee shops and stores.

This is the perfect tour for your first day in Berlin. It is a crash course in Berlin history, from the 16th century through present day. From there, you are equipped with information and recommendations for the rest of your time in Berlin based on what sparked your interest during the all-inclusive tour. Xavier was the most fun tour guide, he has tons of information to share, and a great sense of humour. I laughed out loud a handful of times. He was very conscientious, it was hot and windy the day we toured, and he was great at finding shady spots for all our stops. This tour is amazing value, for $20 and change USD, 4 hours of touring, stories, learning and laughing. Bring a big water bottle and comfy walking shoes and enjoy!
Sarah was great , she was able to expand upon the historical information she was speaking about and was able to put the locations into context for Berliners
Basically very interesting and good tour. What I had to fault was the size of just under 35 (!) Participants and a guide were just too much….

It is a well thought out tours with a lot of information and covers a lot of grounds. I would recommend it for anyone visiting Berlin. However there are some operational downside. The tour group is quite large (Pretty sure they operate outside this booking too) so we might be blocking sideways, or move at different pace. The guide did do a good job organizing the crowd and make sure he is heard. This is a real walking tour for three hours so make sure you bring comfy shoes and enough water!

This was hands down the best 20 euros I spent while in Europe! The guide (Jacob) was very enthusiastic about Berlin and gave amazing information and anecdotes. He was funny as well which made it that much nore enjoyable. It's a little demanding in terms of the distance you will walk but very well worth it and in fact I booked it the very first thing in my trip to Berlin so it can open up other things that I'm particularly interested in to visit in the upcoming days.

Highly recommended!

This is a must book tour for anyone visiting Berlin, especially if you’re lucky enough to get Campbell as a guide. He is such a gifted storyteller and his knowledge of Berlin was beyond impressive. The 3.5 hour timeline seems daunting but it is so incredibly worth it. Definitely give it a go! Thanks for a great tour.
Max was a great guide, really enjoyed the story telling and left feeling like I understood a lot more about Berlin, from its origins in the 15th century to more contemporary history. Highly recommend

Like a quick history lesson on everything that happened and why on this tour. We went a bit over time but because guide took as much time necessary to show us a BUNCH of historical locations and their details
Scott was a great tour guide, knowledgable, eloquent and personable delivery. The tour provided lots of details regarding Berlin’s history and the tour took us to some to the key landmarks.

We had an amazing time on our walking tour, our guide was funny and informative and did a great job fitting so much information in. The tour ran about an hour longer than expected but we didn't mind as we felt it was very valuable.

Glenn was a great guide! He was knowledgeable and personable. Throughout our visit of historical Berlin locations, he gave thoughtful commentary. He even adapted well to a 15 minute downpour! After the tour he gave us some local recommendations, which were awesome!

Excellent tour for the money
Glen was really fabulous. Got a good feel for the influences that shaped the city. Glen very solicitous of all age groups and always made sure we were all there and that we could all see the photos he'd brought.

I took part in this tour with my boyfriend. Our tourguide was Ay. She was fantastic!
A very competent, friendly and entertaining guide! She could tell us everything about each stop, the history behind it and was able to answer any questions from the group. We had such a great time! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
Thank you so much Ay! We’re hoping to book another tour with you when we’ll back in Berlin 😊
A, did the presenting, she had some great (Website hidden by Airbnb) stories as well as providing a nice historical perspective on the environment. Nice energy and strong storytelling.

Glen was amazing. Friendly and very carefully with all the details.
It’s as show!
I strongly recommended the tour with him!
